sql: WITH ord AS (SELECT market_ticker, min(strategy) AS strat, count(DISTINCT strategy) AS ns, min(created_at) AS first_order, min(side) AS side FROM live_orders WHERE action='buy' AND strategy IS NOT NULL GROUP BY market_ticker), pos AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, quantity, realized_pnl FROM positions WHERE market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM ord) ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC), f AS (SELECT o.market_ticker, sum(fl.quantity) AS ct, round(sum(fl.price*fl.quantity)::numeric/nullif(sum(fl.quantity),0),2) AS avgpx, min(fl.filled_at) AS first_fill, sum(fl.fee) AS fee FROM fills fl JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=fl.kalshi_order_id AND o.action='buy' GROUP BY o.market_ticker) SELECT ord.market_ticker, ord.strat, ord.ns, ord.side, ord.first_order, f.first_fill, m.series_ticker, m.close_time, pos.realized_pnl, f.ct, f.avgpx, f.fee FROM ord JOIN pos USING (market_ticker) LEFT JOIN f USING (market_ticker) LEFT JOIN mmsell_settlement_meta m USING (market_ticker) WHERE pos.quantity = 0 AND pos.realized_pnl IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ord.first_order
